name: whatsapp-mcp
description: Self-hosted personal WhatsApp bridge for AI agents. 90 tools over stdio or Streamable HTTP, with read-only and allowlist modes.

store_dir.title: Session and message store
store_dir.description: Where the paired WhatsApp session and local SQLite history are kept. Pair once first with `whatsapp-mcp -store DIR login`.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Remove every tool that can change WhatsApp state.
